Inside a GB202 flagship

TSMC 4N · 92.2 billion transistors · 750 mm² of silicon. An RTX 5090 enables 170 of 192 SMs, 21760 CUDA cores, 96 MB L2, 32 GB GDDR7 at 1.79 TB/s, 575 W TGP. Tap any part to read its card.
